name: consensus_wo_decide-s60-r1
cmd: GDP_INFER_TRACE=2 timeout -s KILL 90 bun research/protocols/run.ts --ms 60000 --only consensus_wo_decide --skip given,broken 2>/tmp/err.log; s=$?; grep -E 'small instance|join (enumerated|end|failed|exists|set|cone|td|houdini)' /tmp/err.log | cut -c1-260 | tail -c 40000; exit $s

cmd: bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null 2>&1; timeout -s KILL 400 bunx tsc -p . 2>&1 | grep -E '^(core|kernel|research/protocols|gates)' | head -20; echo tsc-done; timeout -s KILL 300 bun run lint 2>&1 | grep -E '^  x |-\[' | head -30; echo lint-done
